items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Gerald Brashear, and the interviewee responds with 'oh gosh, all those guys were there,' indicating general awareness of the scene but no specific personal interaction described.

ctx.x: Vernon Brown. I used to love Vernon Brown. Floyd Standifer. The players that were reaching for notes, reaching for some bebop, reaching for...You know, Miles Davis and Dizzy Gillespie and all that music.
Gerald Brashear, oh gosh, all those guys were there.
